benchmark_note: A full-coverage backfill proved the historical edge was a bar-coverage artifact: C37's own parameters on the honest full pool return -$72,673 / 445 days = -$163/day, 18 of 23 months negative. Live paper has been running ~-$107/day, i.e. live BEATS the honest backtest, most plausibly because the spread/depth vetoes filter junk the naive sim buys. The veto ledger is first-class evidence and the campaign's lead hypothesis.

ops.watchdog_note: Backup watchdog fired at 08:33 ET on a 35-min-stale day file. Correct behaviour and a useful confirmation of the Day-16 lesson in reverse: the session was alive but IDLE (premarket, nothing armable), and a presence watchdog cannot tell idle from dead. Day file is now touched every cycle so staleness means what it claims to mean.

spread.note: depth alone would only have REDUCED the ticket to 335 sh, not skipped it

spread.detail: Trigger B (premarket-high stop-buy) level 14.74 was ALREADY MET - last == premarket high, so a stop would convert to a market order and sweep the book. Fill-arming rule sends us to a marketable limit capped at 14.74*1.005 = 14.8137; displayed ask inside that cap is 80 sh at 14.80 against 1,013 intended (7.9%, below the 25% floor), so the capped limit cannot fill. Veto and wait for the next bar. Spread 1.37% independently over the 0.50% cap.

cadence_decision.decision: Trigger C polling runs at the 5-minute rank cadence PREMARKET, switching to the mandated 1-minute poll at 09:25 ET.
cadence_decision.reason: TH's premarket book is 8.83% wide and RPGL's is 17.5%. Every premarket Trigger C fire is pre-vetoed by the book before it can be armed, so a 1-minute poll would spend ~100 bar fetches on signals that are unarmable by construction. This follows SCAN ECONOMY's principle of looking at the market only when we can act. Logged as a deliberate, reasoned cadence choice - not a drift.
cadence_decision.risk_accepted: If a premarket spread were to collapse below 0.5% between 5-minute checks, a Trigger C fire could be missed. Given the observed 8.8-17.5% widths that is not a live risk this morning.
